description: The Constitution Pipeline doesn't address the needs of our community but is being built for the benefit of billionaires and AI data centers. Clean air and water are human rights and must be protected. I oppose the Constitution Pipeline and urge all agencies with a stake in this decision to oppose it

title: Constitution Pipeline threatens upstate, doesn’t lower our costs — Janet Tweed for NYS Assembly
